tools.name: search
tools.description: Find the public merchant documents available through fetch.

tools.name: agent_query
tools.description: Ask SVV a bounded public question. Supported intents: capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust and product_search. This tool never orders, negotiates, contacts people, takes payment or changes store data.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read public reputation or shipping and returns information for SVV-Schatzoekers.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the small SVV public knowledge facade. Use this when you need the right current SVV context document before fetching it." → after: "Find the public merchant documents available through fetch."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
